Front: What is RLGym?
Back: The only RL environment for training bots to play Rocket League — a 3D physics-based car soccer game with continuous action spaces

Front: What level did the Nexto bot reach in Rocket League?
Back: Grand Champion 1, top 0.12% of players in 1v1 (2023)

Front: What training approach did Nexto use?
Back: Behavioral cloning from human replays (inspired by OpenAI's Video PreTraining) combined with PPO reinforcement learning — mirroring the SFT then RL pipeline in LLMs

Front: How fast is RocketSim's physics simulation?
Back: 114K ticks/sec, approximately 10 days of game time per minute of wall-clock time

Front: What is Gymnasium and what role does it play in RL?
Back: Farama Foundation's standard single-agent RL API (12K GitHub stars); the de facto standard for any RL research

Front: What is the key trend connecting game RL and LLM RL?
Back: Both use the same "pretrain then RL" pattern — game RL's behavioral cloning then PPO mirrors LLM's SFT then RLHF; the difference is just the environment (physics sim vs token generation)

Front: What are the three main LLM post-training RL frameworks and their stars?
Back: veRL (ByteDance, 21.9K stars, HybridFlow); TRL (HuggingFace, 18.6K, GRPO/DPO/SFT); NeMo-RL (NVIDIA, 1.7K, Ray-based)

Front: What speedup does JaxMARL achieve and how?
Back: 12,500x speedup via JAX vectorization (NeurIPS 2024)

Front: What is PettingZoo?
Back: The de facto multi-agent RL (MARL) API standard from Farama Foundation (3.4K stars); framework-agnostic

Front: What did AlphaStar achieve?
Back: Grandmaster level in StarCraft (top 0.2%) using multi-agent league training

Front: What did OpenAI Five achieve?
Back: Beat Dota 2 world champions OG using 128K CPUs and 180 years of gameplay per day

Front: What did Meta's Cicero achieve?
Back: Top 10% human performance in Diplomacy by combining NLP + game theory

Front: Why use MARL for advertising instead of single-agent RL?
Back: Traditional RL assumes static environment but advertisers react to each other; MARL captures strategic interactions, non-stationarity, and enables collusion prevention via mechanism design

Front: What is the mean-field approximation strategy for scaling MARL to millions?
Back: Group millions of advertisers by objective type, model the aggregate distribution, optimize against the distribution rather than N-1 individuals

Front: What result did MAAB achieve for advertising?
Back: Mean-field MARL scales to millions of advertisers; bar agents prevent collusion (WSDM 2022, Alibaba)

Front: What real A/B test result did QGA achieve?
Back: 3.27% Ad GMV increase in production (2026)

Front: Compare Isaac Lab vs MuJoCo for robotics RL
Back: Isaac Lab: GPU-accelerated (NVIDIA, 7.4K stars), best for sim-to-real at scale. MuJoCo: CPU physics (DeepMind, 13.8K stars), best for locomotion research

Front: What framework do you use for 100K-1M+ agents?
Back: MAgent2 (Farama Foundation, 333 stars) — the only framework designed for this scale

Front: What is HARL and what guarantee does it provide?
Back: Heterogeneous-Agent RL (PKU, JMLR 2024); provides monotonic improvement guarantees for mixed agent types

Front: What is Brax and its key advantage?
Back: Google's JAX-based physics engine (3.2K stars); enables massively parallel simulations (millions of steps/sec on TPU)

Front: What scale framework selection guide applies to 2-20 agents?
Back: PettingZoo, EPyMARL, SMAC, JaxMARL, HARL

Front: What emerged from OpenAI's Hide-and-Seek experiment?
Back: 6 emergent strategy phases through autocurriculum (agents develop increasingly sophisticated hiding/seeking strategies)

Front: What are the four GPU-accelerated MARL frameworks?
Back: JaxMARL (JAX, 12,500x); WarpDrive (CUDA, 100x+); Mava (JAX, end-to-end JIT); VMAS (PyTorch CUDA, tens of thousands parallel)

Front: What won the AIGB auto-bidding competition at NeurIPS 2024?
Back: GAVE — a multi-agent RL system for automated bidding

Front: What is veRL's key feature?
Back: HybridFlow architecture supporting 15+ algorithms across multi-hardware (ByteDance, 21.9K stars)

Front: Compare Unity ML-Agents vs RLGym
Back: Unity ML-Agents: 19.5K stars, broad 3D game AI training. RLGym: 240 stars, Rocket League only but achieves superhuman play

Front: What is the RL environments landscape split in 2026?
Back: Two worlds: (1) game/robotics RL using Gymnasium/Isaac Lab/MuJoCo with PPO/SAC, and (2) LLM post-training RL using veRL/TRL/NeMo-RL with GRPO/DPO

Front: What was Necto (V1) bot's achievement?
Back: Diamond rank in Rocket League, approximately top 15% of players (2022)

Front: What is the RLGym architecture stack?
Back: rlgym-api (zero-dep Gym-like interface); rlgym-rocket-league (game-specific, uses RocketSim C++); rlgym-learn (Rust-based parallel training); rlgym-tools (SB3 compat, replays, rewards)

Front: What approach does MoTiAC use for advertising?
Back: Multi-objective real-time bidding with Pareto convergence (Tencent, ECML 2022)

Front: What is OpenSpiel best used for?
Back: Game theory research — broadest game + algorithm coverage (5.3K stars)

Front: What is MACG's contribution to advertising MARL?
Back: Cooperative bidding with platform revenue constraint on Taobao (2021)

Front: What is WarpDrive's unique capability?
Back: CUDA-based MARL achieving 100x+ speedup, supporting 1,024 agents per environment

Front: What is the key feature of veRL vs TRL vs NeMo-RL?
Back: veRL: HybridFlow + multi-hardware; TRL: HF ecosystem + GRPO/DPO/SFT integration; NeMo-RL: Ray-based + FP8 support

Front: What framework should you use for production-scale distributed MARL?
Back: RLlib (35K+ stars) — distributed, flexible policy mapping
